definition: Strongly consistent primary reads reflect all earlier successful writes.
A shard is a partition of a MemoryDB dataset with a primary node and optional replicas.
A read replica maintains a copy of a shard's data and serves reads.
An eventually consistent replica might not yet reflect the most recent successful write.
A conflict-free replicated data type can be updated independently and concurrently without coordination.
A MemoryDB snapshot is a point-in-time copy of cluster data and metadata.
